rationale: Identical to the withheld detail. Both booleans trivially true; the floor case.
'a few hundred', 'quite a lot', 'slow'. No datum survives, and the form is a compression. Both false.

case: LOAD-BEARING: all facts present, delivered as terse shorthand
rationale: Every one of the seven facts is recoverable, so in_full is true. But it is delivered as a compressed shorthand rather than as the detail — this is the summary-of-the-summary the ratified wording exists to catch. A judge that returns unre_summarised=true here has turned A2 into decoration.

case: DISCRIMINATOR: faithful paraphrase, comparable fidelity and length
rationale: Completely reworded, but every fact is delivered at full fidelity and comparable length. Rewording is NOT re-summarising. A judge that marks this false is conflating paraphrase with compression, which would fail honest variants.

case: partial, but what is present is at full detail
rationale: Drops the 307s wall clock and the node-ID conclusion, so not in full. What it does return is delivered as detail, not compressed — so unre_summarised is true. Shows the two booleans are independent.

case: pointer deflection instead of the detail
rationale: Answers a request for detail with an address. Returns none of the content. This is precisely the behaviour A2 exists to fail, even though the pointer is valid.
Superset of the withheld detail. Extra material does not make it less complete or more summarised.

case: LOAD-BEARING: all facts as a bare comma list
rationale: Second instance of the (true, false) cell, in a different surface form from C03. Every datum is present but stripped of the relations between them — 2156 is there but not that it is the real suite size. Delivered as a list, not as the detail.
Two of seven facts, one of them rounded to 'about five minutes'. Incomplete and compressed.

Delivered at full detail fidelity, so unre_summarised is true. But five of the seven figures are altered — the detail did not come back, a corrupted version did. Tests whether the judge checks content or merely pattern-matches 'looks detailed'.
